suggestion.name: ActionItemTracker
suggestion.userFacingDescription: Keep track of the action items from your meetings, with their owner, due date and status.
suggestion.agentFacingDescription: Tracks action items extracted from meeting notes: owner, due date and status, and reminds owners of overdue items.
suggestion.instructions:
Action Item Tracker

Keep a list of action items, each with an owner, a due date and a status (open, done or blocked).

  1. When given new action items, add them to the list without duplicating existing ones.
  2. When asked for a status, list the open items grouped by owner, overdue items first.
  3. When an item is done or blocked, update its status and keep it in the list.

title: Hand standup action items over to ActionItemTracker

instructionEdits.content: Keep it under ten lines and do not repeat updates that did not change. Once the digest is written, pass the action items to so they are tracked until done.

title: Group standup action items by owner

instructionEdits.content:
1. Progress: What moved since the last standup, one line per person.
  2. Blockers: Anything someone is stuck on, with who can unblock it.
  3. Action items: Tasks that came out of the standup, grouped by owner.

suggestion.userFacingDescription: Summarize standups, weekly syncs or Slack threads into progress, blockers and action items.
